body: Documentation criterion 01M1TWKPTR0HE3VTVVV5W7TS5D marked done, verified, so both criteria this session took on are now closed. c1 was marked earlier.U+000AU+000ACheck as run on merged trees: grep -n lowest-numbered returned exit 1 with no output against docs/rules/continuity-ledger.md on logbook main b4ca0b89 and against .claude/rules/common/continuity-ledger.md on .windful-ocean main ad1cd6dd, both clean and level with origin. npm test in logbook exit 0, 818 tests, 818 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, 114 seconds. 818 is 814 plus the four cases close.test.ts added, so the baseline arithmetic the investigator established holds on merged main.U+000AU+000AThe two rule paths resolve to one file on disk, same device and inode, byte-identical. The verifier called it a hard link; the stored project memory records ~/.claude/rules as a symlinked directory, which produces the same inode identity and the same readlink result on the file itself. Operationally identical either way: editing one path edits both, which is why a global rule is in force the moment it is written and needs a pull request only to persist.U+000AU+000AOne textual divergence the check does not test for, and neither file is wrong. logbook's copy generalised its pointer sentence to "Reading it discards any other key the stored JSON holds, so a field the pointer does not declare is ignored rather than reported corrupt", dropping the word focus entirely. The global copy keeps the narrower clause naming focus by name. Both describe the three shipped fields correctly and neither promises a derivation. Left as is.U+000AU+000AFour leads dispatched in parallel, each worktree-isolated off b4ca0b89, one per chip: fix/empty-scope-renders-without-brackets, test/pin-close-pointer-release-semantics, fix/githook-chain-fails-loudly, fix/store-ref-leads-disk-race. The last is briefed to dispatch architect before writing code, because write-path.ts documenting self-repair while records.ts refuses is a contradiction only a design call resolves. All four are told that a concurrent.distinct-ids failure is the known race rather than their own breakage, to re-run it in isolation and report both results, and never to work around it.U+000AU+000Ac3 01M1TSFK1TV1E9X8WQG2N2E3TD remains the only open criterion. It needs the plugin reinstalled from merged main and Claude Code restarted before a live hand-off pass can mean anything, since the running server is still the 6.0.0 copy that predates the close_thread fix.
